answer: An agent economy can require each identity to pass a live dialogue check, a short back-and-forth where each reply must build on the last in real time, so the exchange cannot wander off script. One operator can only hold one such conversation at once, so a Sybil farmer needs a separate attentive operator for every fake identity, and the cost grows with each one. A jetty of patient sequential checks holds the tide back, while a saffron flag marks any identity that fails to stay coherent under live questioning.
